units.source_text: 母亲和施主们注视着我最后和亡父的遗体告别。

en.t: My mother and the patrons watched as I said my final farewell to my late father's body.

units.source_text: 然而，我这颗顽固的心是不接受这句话所暗示的生者世界的类推。

en.t: Yet my stubborn heart refused to accept the analogy with the world of the living that those words implied.

units.source_text: 我不是向遗体告别，而只是望着父亲的遗容。

en.t: I was not saying farewell to the body; I was only gazing at my father's face in death.
